improvements_submitted.description: Merged main into develop: restores dotnet.yml CI workflow and several previously-merged library features (arithmetic/TimeSpan/DateTimeOffset interop, IFormattable/IParsable/ISpanParsable, Unix epoch helpers, GeneratedRegex perf, protobuf-net.Core 3.2.56, 411 lines of tests) that existed only on main. Build + 87/87 tests passed on net8/9/10.

monthly_activity_issue.note: Issue #16 (2026-06) was closed by maintainer on 2026-06-17. Created new issue for 2026-10 this run; number not yet known (created via safeoutputs create_issue, resolves post-merge).

notes: Run 2026-10-01: Discovered develop (default branch) had drifted far behind main - missing CI workflow (.github/workflows/dotnet.yml) entirely and ~6 previously-merged repo-assist features/tests (PRs #14,15,17,18,20,22,25,26 all merged to main, none present on develop). Opened PR merging main->develop (2 trivial conflicts in repo-assist.lock.yml/repo-assist.md resolved keeping develop's live workflow config). Build succeeded, 87/87 tests passed all TFMs. Open issues #33/#34/#35 are all auto-generated Repo Assist engine-auth-failure reports (HTTP 401 from provider) - not real bugs, nothing to comment on/fix; they self-expire. Recommend maintainer investigate the recurring 401 auth failures (possible expired COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY). Task 2/5 fell back since no real user issues or additional low-risk improvements were found beyond the sync. No open Repo Assist PRs existed at start of this run (previous ones all merged in June). Next run: check if the sync PR was merged/reviewed; if merged, re-baseline which branch (main vs develop) is canonical going forward to prevent recurrence.
